<div class="card-body">
'''Fire Extinguisher''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">消火装置</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">操縦ドロイドに配備する。配備されている場所で、「予期せぬ損傷」、爆発する「プログラム・トラップ」、またはイオン砲の効果をキャンセルできる。R2－D2に配備されたなら、配備された位置カード上での戦闘をキャンセルできるが、その後「消火装置」はロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Fire-Extinguisher-PSA-161939296.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">R2ユニットのようなドロイドの特殊装備の1つとして、気体噴霧式の消火装置があげられる。電子装置が火を吹いた場合以外にも、戦闘中に相手の目をくらます用途にも使用できる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Fire-extinguishing device.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on an astromech droid. At the location where it is deployed, it may cancel Lateral Damage, an exploding Program Trap, or the effect of an ion cannon. If deployed on R2-D2, it may cancel a battle at that location card, after which Fire Extinguisher is lost.

'''Lore:'''
Among the special equipment of droids such as R2 units is a gas-spray fire extinguisher. Besides when electronic gear catches fire, it can also be used to blind the opponent during battle.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese R2-D2 may cancel a battle at that location card.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Fire Extinguisher]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
